notes: The page also mentions that acceptances begin July 1, 2026. That does not fit with the December deadline. Check the timeline with the director.
name: Health Services Mentorship Program (HSMP)
what_you_do: Do your own health research project with a PhD student mentor, in evening sessions 2 to 3 times a month, then present at the HSMP Colloquium. Fully virtual, no wet lab.
who_can_apply: High school students (GMU's camps list says ages 13 to 17). Virginia applicants must go to certain schools. Students whose family income is under 400% of the federal poverty level get priority. The researcher track is for students with no research experience. It is also for students with few health chances at school.
duration: Spring 2027 cohort starting Jan 20, 2027 (details to be decided); year-long track for fellows and interns
deadline_text: Applications open for the 2027 spring cohort. Deadline Dec 20, 2026; accepted until full.
how_to_apply: Send the online application form. Allow about 14 days for email replies. Some applicants are interviewed. Send questions to the program director, Jonathan Sanchez. His email is jsanche@gmu.edu.
